description: Get an institution's reported put/call derivative positions by CIK (13F options), with pagination and sorting.

cik.description: SEC CIK number of the institution

period.description: 13F report period as its quarter-end date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., "2025-03-31" for Q1 2025). Default: the latest period. A quarter label such as "2025-Q1" is not accepted.

sortBy.description: Sort column: "value" (default) or "shares". Any other value sorts by value.

name: get_institution_derivatives
title: Get Institution Derivatives
